name: Outdoor Custom Infrared Sauna
description: A custom outdoor far-infrared sauna configured for the buyer's site and climate with weather-sealed construction, VantaWave heaters, CORE 5 controls and Western Red Cedar.

source.ref: SaunaCloud official Outdoor Custom Infrared Sauna page
source.note: SaunaCloud told Wellness Fit Check to use its public model and specification pages as the current configurations. Each sauna is custom designed and quote-only; dimensions, circuit requirements, room-air temperature and price vary by project and are not inferred.
